items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: the first time I went to Dr. Samson was in 1929

ctx.x: Dr. Samson. And I want down, the first time I went to Dr. Samson was in 1929, you weren't even born then. I got a filling that he cleaned. It was half a
tooth to show you how good he is. Does it look like half a tooth?
